newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chinon shares dip after sharp rally.
newsitem.headline: Chinon shares dip after sharp rally.

text.p: Shares in Chinon Industries Inc fell back on Monday after gaining on Friday on news that Eastman Kodak and Hachijuni Bank Ltd had agreed to support Chinon's restructuring efforts, brokers said.

At 0442 GMT, the share was down 43 yen at 252 yen, making it the second-biggest percentage loser on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its volume of 528,000 shares was the heaviest on the second section.
On Friday, shares of the video camera lense maker jumped sharply by 61 yen to close at 295 yen.
Under the restructuring program, Chinon will allocate 9.91 million new shares worth 1.88 billion yen to Eastman Kodak and its group companies.
Kodak is already the top shareholder in Chinon with a 12.18 percent stake. The new allocation will raise that to 50.1 percent, Chinon said.
